summary: Pangasinan 4th District representative with 31 principal-authored bills. Authored a tax code amendment and an estate tax amnesty extension; co-authored the national minimum wage, travel-tax abolition and a higher personal income-tax exemption.
caveat: Economic evidence is mixed and mostly co-authored. Rounded half-point average pushed the score to -1.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Tax measures net slightly right: estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition (+2) offset by higher income-tax exemption (-1); co-authored minimum wage (-2). Thin, mostly co-authored.
